surfaces.note: The visible solo play action and the 2/4-player create/join actions enter CockpitSessionScreen. In production CockpitClient targets the deployed Cloudflare Worker.
The App labels this entry '以前のオンライン対戦部屋'; it remains reachable but must not be mistaken for the primary current multiplayer surface.
GameScreen remains reachable when legacy/local store state already exists; it is not the default current play-choice route.

backend.notes: The Worker serves both Cockpit /api/cockpit routes and the public-online room API surface.
